ideas.name: Start with the decision.
ideas.definition: Name the decision, the person making it and the evidence it needs before choosing a model.
ideas.why: A model is a component. A useful product also needs a person, evidence, a next action and a way to judge whether the decision improved. Starting there makes the limits visible before an experiment grows.
checklist: Write one decision as a question a person needs to answer.
Name the person responsible for the next action.
List the evidence and what would make it insufficient.
Choose an acceptance rule before comparing tools.

ideas.name: Where the AI must stop.
ideas.definition: Make the point for human checking, override or sign-off part of the product.
ideas.why: An answer and an action carry different consequences. Property identity, missing information, permissions and accountability need explicit checks. A person must be able to see the evidence and stop or override the proposed action.
apply: Read about human review in real estate
Check the property identity and source
checklist: Identify the error that could affect the decision.
Put the human check before that consequence.
Show source, date and uncertainty at the check.
Specify what happens when evidence or approval is missing.

ideas.name: Cost per accepted result.
ideas.definition: Include retries, failures and review when counting the cost of a result that meets an explicit acceptance rule.
ideas.why: A cheaper request may require more retries or review. Count the full workflow cost against distinct results that meet an explicit acceptance rule. The cost ledger records caller acceptance; it does not independently certify the output.
apply: Use the cost ledger and fictional worked examples
checklist: Define what counts as one distinct result.
Write the acceptance rule and who applies it.
Record failed attempts, retries, tool costs and review time.
Report no accepted results as undefined cost per result, not zero.

احمدرضا صمدی هم‌بنیان‌گذار و مدیرعامل Royal Abraj Group در دبی است و از سال ۲۰۲۲ این نقش را دارد. این گروه در حوزهٔ کارگزاری املاک و خدمات انجام امور اسناد فعالیت می‌کند. او راهبرد دیجیتال و فناوری آن، از جمله وب‌سایت‌ها، گردش‌کارهای CRM، پورتال مشتریان و ابزارهای داخلی را هدایت می‌کند.
